lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the posterior lateral surface, following the body curvature. These clusters are separated by approximately two blob-diameters in both horizontal and vertical planes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a lattice-like structure on the mid-to-posterior flank region.
